title: RS2 Presentations Forum
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
I have created an "RS2 Presentations" forum as a repository of large files for use with RS2 presentations, such as Powerpoint slides, animated GIFs, large images or other reference material. If your total file size is in excess of 75k, please upload to the RS2 Presentations, as that forum is not linked to an email list and our dial-up users of the regular forums will not have to spend the day downloading email. But please keep discussion in the main forums, so they can continue to contribute without having to visit the website.

Thanks!
